title: Hatsune Miku — Voices In Unison〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm glad the girls' music video shoot went so well.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, me too!
They gave me goosebumps because they looked so awesome♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
And they played well.
They all seemed really confident about themselves.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I agree. I thought I knew about how much they've grown up to this point...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But today, their performance made my heart jump. It was like they were absolutely determined to have their song heard by as many people as possible.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I felt as if I'd been hit by a wave of their emotions while listening.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I hope they succeed...
I really want more people to hear their song.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
They totally will☆
I mean, their performance was just that amazing!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I bet people around the world are gonna hear them and say, “Wow! Check out Leo/need♪”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You know it's not gonna be that easy, right...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Why not? They played so well today!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know...
But the world's full of even more amazing bands, including professional ones.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So... Um...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There's plenty of other incredible songs and performances in this sea of music.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And Leo/need has to compete against all of them and find ways to turn people's heads, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Do you think they're not gonna be able to do that, Miku-P...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, I'm just trying to say that there's a very big world out there. Bigger than we realize...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And the girls practice each day because they're fully aware of that fact.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, they're gonna feel a lot of pressure if our expectations become too inflated.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, right...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
But I know how you feel, Rin.
I also want lots and lots of people to see the girls' music video.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: At the very least, I was incredibly moved by the way they played.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It may've been just for a music video, but I'm incredibly glad that I got to witness that...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me too! We were the only ones there, so it was like... Uhh... A private show, right?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I don't think that's quite...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Ugh! Forget the details!
Anyway, let's talk more about their video♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Sakki was so amazing during the chorus!
It's like she was able to channel all of her feelings into each note!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, Saki definitely seemed to be on a roll. It was like she was saying, “Get ready for the chorus! Here it comes!” And she really pulled everyone forward.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She did. Honami and Shiho had perfect synergy with her too, which created such a wonderful vibe.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. They provided the foundation that allowed her synth to really shine through.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And then, the way Ichika played her guitar! That was so cool!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, it was...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She sounded so much better than usual. I could feel each note resonating with my heart...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, same!
Ichi was so cool!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I really wanna see them play like that again...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It won't be live, but you can watch their music video as many times as you like.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, that's right!
Len, you're a genius!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I'm not sure how I feel about that...
If anything, I feel like you're sorta making fun of me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, I'm not making fun of you! Honest!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Getting everyone around the world to suddenly hear the girls' song like Rin says is a tall order...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But there are definitely people out there who know how good their music is.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I really hope they succeed...)
